title: 夠

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L231-S01 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Family dinner table at home with protagonist mother looking at remaining rice and dishes on the table; protagonist little girl, protagonist father, and protagonist older brother sit around the table, and the remaining food clearly still looks enough for everyone to share.
Visual cast: protagonist mother with white or beige top, wide blue pants, shoulder-length dark hair; protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; protagonist father with blue shirt or jacket, white shirt, khaki pants; protagonist older brother with blue-and-white striped top. Use L154/L162/L163 family continuity. L058 is style reference only, not a face or clothing reference.
Composition: centered dining table with visible shared dishes, all four family members clearly visible, food amount moderate and reassuring, safe margins for phone square crop.
Style: warm hand-painted watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft edges and friendly family expressions.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, labels, logos, brands, watermarks, readable marks, or sad scarcity mood.
sentences.imageNotes: 家裡餐桌場景，主角媽媽看著桌上剩下的一些飯菜，主角小女孩、主角爸爸、主角哥哥都在桌邊，飯菜看起來還夠全家人分著吃。畫面重點是「剩下的飯菜仍然夠大家吃」，不要做成很少或很可憐。不可有文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L231-S02 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. After outdoor play, protagonist little girl and protagonist older brother look at one transparent water bottle that has only a tiny amount of water left; both children look thirsty, and the small amount is clearly not enough for both to drink.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; protagonist older brother with blue-and-white striped top and a clearly older child body shape. Family continuity from L154/L162/L163; L058 style only.
Composition: centered bottle between the two children, very low water level visible without any measurement marks, outdoor play setting, safe margins.
Style: warm watercolor children's illustration, gentle and non-distressing.
Avoid: no text, numbers, measurement marks, bottle brand, labels, logos, watermarks, readable marks, or exaggerated dehydration.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角哥哥在戶外玩後看著一個透明水壺，裡面只剩很少一點水，兩人都很渴，明顯不夠分著喝。水壺不能有文字、數字、刻度、品牌或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L231-S03 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At home, protagonist mother takes only half of the cookies out of a plain box and places them on the table; the other half remains inside the box, and protagonist little girl looks at the amount as if asking whether it is enough.
Visual cast: protagonist mother with white or beige top, wide blue pants, shoulder-length dark hair; protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. L154/L162/L163 continuity; L058 style reference only.
Composition: table centered, open plain box clearly showing cookies still inside and a smaller group on the table, mother and girl fully visible, safe margins.
Style: warm watercolor family-life illustration.
Avoid: no text, numbers, brands, box labels, packaging marks, logos, watermarks, readable marks, or written quantity symbols.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角媽媽和主角小女孩在家裡，媽媽從盒子裡只拿出一半的餅乾放到桌上，另一半餅乾還留在盒子裡，小女孩看著桌上的份量像是在問夠不夠。餅乾和盒子不可有文字、數字、品牌或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L231-S04 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist father checks an old small electric ride-on car or electric toy car; its headlight is very dim and the car looks weak from low power, while protagonist little girl watches nearby.
Visual cast: protagonist father with blue shirt or jacket, white shirt, khaki pants; protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. Family continuity from L154/L162/L163; L058 style only.
Composition: old toy vehicle centered with dim light visible, father kneeling or leaning beside it, girl nearby, safe margins.
Style: warm watercolor home or yard illustration, calm problem-solving mood.
Avoid: no battery level numbers, dashboard text, labels, license plates, brands, logos, watermarks, readable marks, warning icons, or readable symbols.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角爸爸在一台老舊的小電動車或電動玩具車旁邊檢查，車燈很暗，主角小女孩在旁邊看著。畫面要呈現「舊車電力不足」，但不能出現電量數字、儀表文字、車牌、標籤或任何可讀文字。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L231-S05 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl quietly reads a new book at home or in a classroom; the book is open around the middle, with page thickness on the left and right looking about half and half, and a simple bookmark near the middle.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. Family continuity from L154/L162/L163; L058 style reference only.
Composition: girl and open book centered, the halfway page position easy to understand, safe margins, calm reading posture.
Style: warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft light.
Avoid: no readable book cover, page text, numbers, labels, brand logos, watermarks, school names, captions, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩坐在家裡或教室安靜看一本新書，書翻到中間位置，左右頁厚度看起來約各一半。可有書籤夾在中間，但書頁與封面不可有可讀文字、數字、品牌或標籤。
